label: Activity under a local relay and an independent active feed
term: local relay activity with an independent active feed
definition: A position is active with respect to the selected power exactly when it has a separate active feed or its immediate successor has that power active and the successor link is intact.
note: This extends the local successor-only transmission rule to a specified additional input. Independence means the feed is kept active under the selected interventions on successor links. The origin of the feed remains open.
